task_description: Audit the DEMAze Technologies marketing site (layout, performance, design/UX, accessibility, correctness) and fix the highest-value, lowest-risk production-readiness issues that CI can validate: make marketing claims/copy honest (unsubstantiated homepage metrics, over-promising playbook form, future-dated legal/footer), and fix concrete perf/UX/a11y issues in interactive components (offscreen hero-video pausing, PinnedServicesShowcase touch discoverability + stacked-image a11y + keyboard focus). Responsive-image srcset is deferred: it requires regenerating the generated src/assets/images.ts via sharp, which is not installable in the INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox and must not be hand-edited.

verification.summary: The four quality checks (typecheck/lint/test/build) could NOT run locally: sandbox network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, node_modules lacks tool binaries (.bin/tsc, eslint, vitest absent), and the npm registry is unreachable (npm install/npx -> 403). CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml: npm ci + typecheck + lint + test + build on push/PR) is the authoritative validator and has network access. Static verification done locally: grep confirms no fabricated claims remain (45+/$10M/35+/6+/2026); the metrics array keeps exactly 4 [value,label] as const entries so site-data.test.ts (metrics toHaveLength(4), projects.length>=16) still holds; edits match existing Prettier/ESLint formatting by construction; generated files (images.ts, routeTree.gen.ts) untouched. Test quality: the existing meaningful tests (site-data.test.ts, submission-guards.test.ts) still guard the changed content; no new tests added because the remaining changes are copy edits plus DOM/IntersectionObserver and CSS behaviour not exercisable in the headless sandbox (Playwright/browser unavailable). Semantic review (v1) APPROVED; its single non-blocking note (reduced-motion resume could start an off-screen video) was fixed by making the IntersectionObserver the sole resume authority.
